summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan retiring the three machine-wide Sapience activation surfaces (the sapienceMcpServer activation entry in modules/home/services/sapience.nix, seven permissions.allow grants, and five hook entries in config/claude/settings.json) while adding the one durable per-project MCP-registration SessionStart entry. Three plan-time findings corrected or extended the research report: hooks.SessionEnd holds two entries, not one (the systemd sleep-inhibitor cleanup must be kept); packages/sapience-flake/ carries a second copy of the module that is a standalone publishable flake and is ruled out of scope; and _SAPIENCE_NOTE is not an enforced key, so a rewritten note will not propagate to the live file. Verification tiers were measured with suite_selection_select rather than asserted, which surfaced test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh as a directly relevant covering suite for the settings.json phase.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: confirm companion landing, remove the nix activation entry, retire grants/hooks and add the durable registration entry, rewrite docs, produce the owner instruction and coordination record, then gate and verify against live merged state.
